In this notebook, I will make plots for Main Figure 6

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpmisc)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```


```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```

# Cell Frequency

```{r, fig.width=3.25, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellsubtype",
  filterCol = "cellsubtype",
  filterVal = c("Tfh"),
  relative.to = "tgroup",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), size = 4,
             shape = 21, alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  facet_grid(~cellsubtype) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.format", vjust = 1.4, size = 5) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Percentage of CD4 T Cells", 
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",

  relative.to = "cellsubtype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), size = 4,
             shape = 21, alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  facet_grid(~cellstate) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, label = "p.format", vjust = 1.4, size = 5,
                     label.y = c(0.95, 1.05, 1.15, 1.25)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1.3)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Percentage of Tfh Cells", 
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

# Gene Expression

```{r, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% 
    droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  features = c("MAF", "PDCD1", "IL21", "CXCL13"),
  relative.to = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("PD1Hi Tfh"),
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, cellstate, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal, color = diagSub, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), color = "black", width=0.3, linewidth=0.4, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0)) +
  facet_grid(~featureVar, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("cCD", "UC")), label = "p.format", vjust = 2, size = 5, tip.length = 0.05, bracket = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.55)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "Mean Gene Expression\n(PD1Hi Tfh Cells)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

# Regressions

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4.5}
SenderReceiver(
    seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & timepoint == "T0")  %>%  droplevels,
    seurat = "seuobj",
    senderCol = "cellstate",
    senderVal = c("PD1Hi Tfh"),
    senderProp = TRUE,
    senderRelative = "cellsubtype",
    senderMinDenomFreq = 10,
    receiverCol = "cellstate",
    receiverVal = c("Th17"),
    receiverProp = TRUE,
    receiverRelative = "cellsubtype",
    receiverMinDenomFreq = 10,
    facetType = "grid",
    facet_scales = "free_x",
    facet_dir = "v",
    ncol = 4,
    stripSize = 14,
    axisXsize = 16,
    axisYsize = 16,
    regSize = 5,
    groupReg = T,
    fillReg = T,
    exportSampleDF = T
) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = prop.sender, y = prop.receiver, color = diagSub, group = diagSub)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), shape = 21, stroke = 1.5, size = 5, alpha = 1, color = "black") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.2), xlim = c(0, 1)) +
    stat_poly_line(method = "lm") +
    stat_poly_eq(method = "lm", use_label(c("R2", "P")), size = 7, vstep = 0.1, vjust=0.575) +
    labs(
        x = "PD1Hi Tfh Frequency\n(Relative to Tfh)", 
        y = "Th17 Frequency\n(Relative to Thelper)", 
        size = "# Cells", 
        fill = NULL,
        color = NULL,
        subtitle = NULL) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.25, 0.5, 0.25, 0.25), "cm"),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm")
    )
```


```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4}
SenderReceiver(
    seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & timepoint == "T0") %>%  droplevels,

    facet_grid(~senderExp, scales = "free") +

    ) +
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
SenderReceiver(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & timepoint == "T0") %>%  droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  senderCol = "cellstate",
  senderVal = c("PD1Hi Tfh", "Th17"),
  features.sender = c("CXCL13", "IL17A"),
  senderProp = FALSE,
  senderRelative = "cellstate",
  minSenderFreq = 10,
  receiverCol = "cellstate",
  receiverVal = c("IgG1 PC"),
  receiverProp = TRUE,
  receiverRelative = "celltype",
  receiverMinDenomFreq = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_x",
  facet_dir = "v",
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  ncol = 4,
  stripSize = 14,
  axisXsize = 16,
  axisYsize = 16,
  regSize = 5,
  groupReg = T,
  fillReg = T,
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>% 
  filter(senderName %in% c("PD1Hi Tfh_CXCL13", "Th17_IL17A")) %>% 
  mutate(senderName = case_when(
    senderName == "PD1Hi Tfh_CXCL13" ~ "PD1Hi Tfh - CXCL13",
    senderName == "Th17_IL17A" ~ "Th17 - IL17A"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = senderExp, y = prop.receiver, group = diagSub, color = diagSub)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), color = "black", size = 3.5, shape = 21, stroke = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm") +
  stat_poly_eq(method = "lm", use_label(c("R2", "P")), rsquared.conf.level = 0.999, size = 6, vstep = 0.1, hjust=-0.05) +
  facet_grid(~senderName, scales = "free") +
  guides(
    ) +
```
